text:
support_lead: FYI customer (AcmeRetail) hitting recurring 504s during traffic spikes, reported 3 incidents in last 2 hours. They say requests queue and timeout for ~40s before gateway 504. escalation ticket: INC-8421
customer_ops: Repro steps they gave: call /v1/generate with a 2k token prompt, 50 RPS for ~30s. Gateway returns 504, then success after ~60s. We see big latency spikes in frontend logs.
support_lead: attaching sample logs (trimmed) and timeline. please triage @sre_oncall
sre_oncall: looking. any known deploys? @ops_bot when did autoscaler last change?
ops_bot: Deploys: none in last 24h. Scaler: KEDA v2.7, HPA bridged; scaledobject present for model-service-prod, cooldown 300s, pollingInterval 30s.
ashok: can you paste the model-service readiness probe config? suspect warmup/init delay causing readiness to not flip true during scaleup
maria: readiness YAML: ```
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /health/ready
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 10
  failureThreshold: 3
```
kevin: container has heavy python model init; cold start ~45-60s on p3.large. We have a model warmup script that runs on postStart but sometimes times out.
sre_oncall: that matches customer timings. If KEDA observes queue metric late (polling 30s) + HPA cooldown 300s + container init 60s => total path > gateway timeout. Also noticed scaledobject has "activationThreshold: 10" but their bursts are 40-50 RPS, so activation should be fine.
customer_ops: here are a few gateway traces (ids censored): ``[gateway] 2026-02-21T15:02:14Z -> 504 upstream timeout after 42.3s -> route model-service-prod``
maria: I see multiple 504s clustered at the same minute, then a flood of successful requests after ~80s. Suggests scaleup happened but too late.
nashok: also check keda scaledobject annotations: we have `scaledobject.keda.sh/metricName: redis-queue-length` and `cooldownPeriod: 300`. Maybe cooldown is preventing down->up oscillation?
kevin: I reproduced locally: KEDA poll lag + readiness probe keeps pod NotReady for 50s because postStart warmup script blocked. Log snippet: ``ERROR Warmup timed out after 30s, aborting warmup``
sre_oncall: aha — postStart uses 30s timeout while readiness probe expects service ready earlier. mismatch. If postStart times out, app still takes longer to serve, readiness stays false and HPA/KEDA keeps scaling slowly.
support_lead: customer mentioned auth errors occasionally during these bursts too (403s). Could be tokens expired when queue delays spike — but separate. Focus on scale.
nashok: mitigation options: 1) increase postStart warmup timeout; 2) add /warmup endpoint invoked by lifecycle or prewarm job; 3) reduce KEDA pollingInterval to 5s during high-burst tier; 4) add a small pre-warmed pool (minReplicas>0) for this model.
maria: short term patch: bump readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds to 20 and increase postStart timeout to 90s (or make warmup async and return 200 earlier). That avoids probe flapping.
kevin: also propose lowering HPA cooldown or KEDA cooldownPeriod to 60s for this scaledobject; current 300s is too conservative for bursty customers.
sre_oncall: planning: 1) apply readiness change to staging and run customer repro (50 RPS for 60s) 2) reduce keda polling to 10s on canary scaledobject 3) set minReplicas=1 for this tenant's nodepool if SLA.
support_lead: customer asked for ETA to stop 504s in next 24h. Can we do a safe canary?
ashok: yes — I'll roll staged readiness change + keda polling change to canary (1% traffic) in 30m. If metrics look stable, roll to their cluster.
sre_oncall: also adding temporary gateway backoff: increase upstream timeout to 120s for route model-service-prod to reduce 504 noise while we fix scale behavior.
customer_ops: appreciate it. we'll coordinate a controlled test at 1400 UTC to reproduce. pls share repro script.
kevin: repro script gist: ``for i in `seq 1 50`; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d @payload.json & done`` payload.json uses long prompt.
sre_oncall: followups: add metric: podReadyLatency (time from PodScheduled->Ready). dashboards updated. create follow-up ticket SRE-1192 to track cooldown/ready mismatch.
support_lead: recording timeline and decisions in INC-8421. thanks team :thumbsup:
